cohort: 100 women with uterine rupture (50 with scarred uterus and 50 without) admitted to Sheikh Zaid Women Hospital, Larkana, Pakistan, between January 2016 and March 2019.
finding: Unscarred uterine rupture was associated with higher death rates and more undelivered fetuses, while scarred uterine rupture was associated with prior cesarean section.
